email.body1:
Remington, saw Akash launched AkashML inference and opened the Homenode beta, running Blackwell jobs at roughly 70 to 85 percent below cloud cost.

Momentum like that usually puts more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Akash off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Remington, quick follow-up for Akash.

As AkashML and Homenode pull in new AI and developer demand, the target usually outruns headcount. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Akash needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Remington, last bit of proof for Akash.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Akash's reply rate likely compares to other infra and developer-tools teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
